field.label: Pick from catalog
field.help: Searchable list of the resolvers in the signed public-resolvers.md catalog (name, country, protocol, description). Only DNSCrypt resolvers can be anonymized; the others are shown greyed out. Picking one fills in the name and the operator below; both stay editable.

field.label: Enabled
field.help: Only enabled resolvers are written to server_names. An enabled resolver needs at least one relay.

field.label: Resolver
field.help: Resolver name as in public-resolvers.md, for example cs-de.

field.label: Operator
field.help: Who runs this resolver. Pre-filled from the name (first label, aliases such as cs → cryptostorm). Relays with the same operator are locked in the route matrix.

field.label: Relays
field.help: The relays this resolver may use (the same as the ticks in its matrix row). Two or more give failover.
